claims.claim: Clean Sonny PS4 slim station with 8 to 10 games installed and one pad
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a closed grey laptop with a printed lid watermark; no PS4 console, controller/pad, or game discs/cases are shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working
claims.evidence: No power-on test, ports close-up, or internal/opened status is shown; only the laptop lid/hinge area is partially visible.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No controller/pads or receipt are shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Item mismatch/scam risk: the seller describes a PS4 slim, but the witness photos show a laptop.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing the exact item being sold (PS4 console front/back + controller/pad + game cases) matching the listing, or a clear correction that it is actually a laptop.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-matching/uncertain item (worst case: treat as not as described).

risks.risk: Laptop specs unknown (brand/model, RAM, storage type/size, CPU/GPU).
risks.proof: Photo of the laptop bottom label (model/serial) and a screenshot of system info (e.g., CPU-Z / Speccy) showing RAM and SSD/HDD details.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest spec assumption (worst case: older/low-RAM with HDD or unknown storage).

risks.risk: Condition unknown: screen quality, keyboard condition, hinge integrity, and body damage not shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of screen (on/off), keyboard (all keys), trackpad, and hinge/body from multiple angles; include any cracks/dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/used with unknown wear (worst case: screen/keyboard issues).

risks.risk: Power/boot and performance unknown (may not power on, may boot with errors, overheating).
risks.proof: Video showing power-on, BIOS/boot screen, and a quick benchmark or normal boot into OS.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / possibly faulty (worst case: non-working).

risks.proof: Screenshot from battery report (Windows: powercfg /batteryreport) or battery health app showing cycle count/capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as low battery health (worst case: needs replacement).

risks.proof: Video showing each port in use (USB device, HDMI to external display) and Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth connection test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports may be unreliable (worst case: limited functionality).

risks.risk: Accessories/charger not shown; missing charger makes it hard to test and reduces value.
risks.proof: Photo of the charger/adapter (label/wattage) and a video charging the laptop while powered on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as charger not included or unverified (worst case: no charger).

proof_requests: Confirm whether the item is a PS4 slim or a laptop; send photos that clearly match the exact item being sold.
If it’s a laptop: send the bottom label (brand/model/serial) and a system info screenshot showing RAM and storage (SSD/HDD).
Send a power-on/boot video and a quick check of keyboard + trackpad.
Send screen close-ups (including screen-on) and hinge/body close-ups for cracks/dents.
Send port test video (USB, HDMI if available) and Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth connection test.
Show charger/adapter included (photo of adapter label) and charging video.
response.reason: The witness photos show a laptop, while the seller claims a PS4 slim with games and a controller—this mismatch prevents reliable pricing. Additional proof is required to confirm the exact item and its working condition/specs.
